product.title: 5hs Small Group City Tour of Buenos Aires (optional street food)

description.text: In Buenos Aires, this five-hour small-group city outing covers Plaza de Mayo, Puerto Madero, San Telmo, La Boca, Recoleta, and Palermo, with hotel pickup and drop-off listed. A local guide handles neighborhood pacing and live commentary; an optional street-food snack upgrade appears separately from the From price. The published cap is about 16. The format suits visitors who want a longer guided sightseeing introduction without coordinating each district independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Buenos Aires, and the itinerary stays on those six districts that shape this city day rather than a private Recoleta walk or a gaucho ranch outing.
